description: Address GitHub issue #315. Preserve tagged thaw results at the InstanceManager start boundary; start fresh only when storage is disabled or the checkpoint is absent; return structured thaw errors without registering a child; add regression coverage for corrupt checkpoints with an ahead-of-zero journal and verify durable data remains unchanged.

comments.text: Implemented explicit fresh/restored thaw start modes and fail-closed error propagation as {:error, {:thaw_failed, reason}}. Added corrupt file-checkpoint regression with rev-2 journal invariants plus generic non-not-found error coverage. Validation: mix test test/jido/agent/instance_manager_test.exs (33 passed); mix q passed; mix test passed.
Draft PR opened: https://github.com/agentjido/jido/pull/316. Commit d1d02a4; branch jido-7mc/fail-closed-thaw.

title: Fail closed on InstanceManager thaw errors
